title: Creating plots based on hydrochemical data
text: diagram, devised Geert Van Wirdum, shows chemical similarity water sample references samples atmocline water (rainwater), thalassocline water (seawater) lithocline water (calcium rich, fresh groundwater). diagram plots ionic ratio, [Ca2+]/([Ca2+]+[Cl−])[Ca^{2+}] / ([Ca^{2+}] + [Cl^{-}]) (equivalent concentrations), logarithm electrical conductivity 25°C. electrical conductivity available samples Watina, need compute ionic ratio. manually sample watina package also contains calculate_ir() function can applied directly output get_chem() function calculate ionic ratio: obtained dataset wide table following fields (namely fields input dataset new field ir contains calculated ionic ratio): Now can create diagram ionic ratio (log ) electrical conductivity 25°C (called Van Wirdum diagram) ggplot_vanwirdum_background() function. function create background Van Wirdum diagram, reference points lithotrophic water (Li), atmotrophic water (), thalassotrophic water (Th) optionally molunotrophic water (Rh - polluted water found Rhine).  can show mixing contours reference points curve instead line plot reference point polluted river water using respectively contour rhine arguments:  Now let’s add data valley Kesterbeek. example plot 2 locations sampled twice 2024:  usual options ggplot2 available customize layout plot.
